concept: One early moment decided the game, so the carousel is built like a match clock. The hero puts the setup in grey (Pochettino's first game) and the twist in white (10 men after 8 minutes), with 4-0 and 8' as the two numbers underneath. Slide 2 is a timeline drawn as bars: each bar's length is the minute it happened, so the glowing red card bar and the two goals that followed sit together as three short bars at the top while Ngumoha and Munoz trail off below, showing how early the game was gone. Slide 3 is one giant clock figure (2:45 between the first two goals) and slide 4 the Opta first. The last slide turns to the table and hands fans the red card debate. Football green, pitch lines and type only: no player photos, no club crests.
caption:
Pochettino's first game at Manchester United lasted eight minutes as a contest.

Leny Yoro was sent off for bringing down Alexander Isak on the edge of the box. Within five minutes Liverpool were 2-0 up through a Szoboszlai free kick and a Wirtz volley. Rio Ngumoha and Victor Munoz added the rest. Final score: Liverpool 4-0 Manchester United.

Opta says no manager had ever had a red card plus two goals conceded in the first half of his Premier League debut. United are now in the relegation zone, one point off the bottom. Liverpool move up to fourth.
